summary: DueByte 0.3.62 includes qualified early founder-award funding and per-server collateral accounting. The planned 900 DUBYT advance is deducted from the existing founder award; planned server funding is 10 support plus 90 personal collateral. These are preparation rules only. Installation does not issue tokens, pledge funds, start warmup or activate mainnet exchange. Existing chain, wallet keys, balances and signing history are retained. Home61 updates automatically; Linux Server requires coordinated manual installation. Windows executable is not Microsoft-code-signed; verify the signed DueByte channel. The candidate notice inside the immutable archive is superseded by this release notice.
